name: codex-team-orchestrator
description: A dependency-free Codex Skill and configuration kit for coordinating scoped read-only research, bounded implementation, and evidence-based verification.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate scoped Codex roles and verify results.
interface.longDescription: Makes orchestration available implicitly across software-engineering work while keeping simple tasks in the root thread, Terra discovery read-only, Luna implementation bounded, creation budgets explicit, and verification evidence-based. Model availability, permissions, concurrency, and token cost remain runtime-dependent.
defaultPrompt: Use $orchestrator to plan, delegate only useful bounded work, and verify the result.
